text:
maya: hitting a weird one on edge runtime + ts sdk v1.7.4 — streaming responses sometimes become unreadable after token refresh/retry. getReader() throws 'stream is locked' on subsequent reads.

kevin: ugh, do you have a tiny repro? which runtime (vercel, node)?

maya: Vercel edge. repro steps: deploy a simple endpoint that proxies /v1/chat/stream with Authorization header. we rotate tokens on 401 and retry the request. sometimes the client code that reads the response body fails after a retry.

maya: minimal client snippet:
```
const res = await fetch(url, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
const reader = res.body.getReader();
while (true) {
  const { done, value } = await reader.read();
  if (done) break;
  // process chunk
}
```

maya: logs from the edge function:
```
TypeError: Failed to execute 'getReader' on 'ReadableStream': stream is locked
    at Object.readChunks (/workspace/index.js:45:20)
    at processRequest (/workspace/index.js:78:10)
```

samir: thanks. couple quick Qs: 1) exact SDK @npm package and version? 2) do you see the failure predictably after a token refresh flow or randomly? 3) any HTTP 204/empty responses in the mix?

maya: SDK: @redwood/inference-js 1.7.4. it's correlated with token refresh + fast retry (we issue a new fetch after swapping auth). no 204s AFAICT — SSE/text/event-stream.

samir: got it. hypothesis: when you abort/ignore the original response and kick off a retry, the underlying ReadableStream can become locked in edge runtimes (especially in Vercel edge workers) if response.clone()/tee() isn't used or if the stream is piped while the engine is re-used. two temporary workarounds:

1) avoid calling getReader on the same response object after a retry — ensure old reader is cancelled before retrying:
```
await reader.cancel();
```

2) clone/tee the body up-front if you need multiple consumers:
```
const tee = res.body.tee();
const r1 = tee[0].getReader();
const r2 = tee[1].getReader();
```

kevin: also try upgrading to 1.8.1 — we shipped a fix that delays automatic retry scheduling in edge until the body stream is fully consumed or cancelled. can you test on that version?

maya: will try upgrade and add explicit cancel. quick question: is response.clone() supported on Vercel edge? saw inconsistent behavior across runtimes.

samir: clone()/tee() are supported in many edge environments but some older workers had a bug where clone() would still mark the original locked. that's what 1.8.1 addresses by forcing an API-safe consumption path before retry. if you can't upgrade immediately, please ensure cancellation before issuing a new fetch.

maya: upgraded to 1.8.1 locally — initial smoke looks better. no locked stream after token swap so far. will run load test.

infra-bot: created BUG-4521: edge-worker-stream-lock-on-retry, assigned to eng-runtime. :spiral_note_pad:

kevin: thanks @maya, @samir. keep us posted and ping if load repro still fails — we'll escalate with a trace.

maya: will do — thanks! :thumbsup:
